newsitem.title: LEBANON: Masked gunman kills former guerrilla in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Masked gunman kills former guerrilla in Lebanon.

text.p: A masked gunman killed a former member of a radical Palestinian guerrilla group in a south Lebanon refugee camp on Tuesday, Lebanese security sources said.

The gunman opened fire with a sub-machinegun at 27-year-old Khalil Ward, killing him instantly, as he headed to work in the morning at the Ain el-Hilweh camp near the southern port of Sidon, 40 km (25 miles) south of Beirut, the sources said.
Until two years ago, Ward was a member of the Fatah Revolutionary Council (FRC), headed by guerrilla leader Sabri al-Banna or Abu Nidal, the sources added.
It was not immediately known who was behind the murder, the second committed in the camp by a masked gunman since the start of the year.
Inter-Palestinian feuds have claimed the lives of several officials and members of the rival groups in Lebanon in recent years.
The FRC, which is opposed to Arab-Israeli peace talks, split from Fatah in 1973.
